company.shortDescription: Mineflow is an AI platform for predicting mineral deposit shapes and locations, helping mining companies from exploration to feasibility.

productsAndServices.description: An AI platform that predicts mineral deposit shapes and locations using geological data to support mining exploration and feasibility studies.
productsAndServices.name: Mineflow AI Mineral Exploration Platform

productsAndServices.description: A system that automatically reads and extracts georeferenced data from hundreds of file formats without manual intervention, organizing exploration data for analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Data Ingestion and Processing System

productsAndServices.description: Tools for creating interactive 3D visualizations and cross sections of drill hole data to analyze subsurface geology and mineralization patterns.
productsAndServices.name: 3D Drill Data Visualization Tools

productsAndServices.description: A suite of geostatistical models and data export functions that support site predictions and integration with major geological modeling software.
productsAndServices.name: Mineflow Estimator Models and Export Capabilities
